title: Israeli Authorities Charge 12 Guards in Beating Death of Palestinian Prisoner
summary_full: The rare prosecution comes amid widespread reports from rights groups about mistreatment in Israeli detention centers, where, activists say, scores of Palestinians have died since October 2023.
